title: Refactor Kit Kinds Across All Languages
description: Refactor all kit implementations across all programming languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, C#) to support exactly five kit kinds: FileKit (JSON), FolderKit (local folder with .semio/kit.db sqlite), ArchiveKit (zip of FolderKit), RemoteKit (url), TemporaryKit (InMemory). Add KitKind enum, conversion functions, and comprehensive tests for all five kinds in all languages.
summary:
Implemented actual kit import/export/edit workflows across the language bindings instead of only adding enums.

Updated bindings:
- semio/js/index.ts: added importFileKit, exportFileKit, importArchiveKit, importRemoteKit, editTemporaryKit, expanded importKit dispatch, and workflow tests for file/remote/temporary helpers.
- semio/go/kit_sqlite.go + semio_test.go: added Import/Export/Edit helpers for FileKit, FolderKit, ArchiveKit, RemoteKit, TemporaryKit; added workflow tests covering all five kinds.
- semio/py/main.py: added file/folder/remote import-export-edit helpers, implemented folder SQLite reconstruction, and added tests for all five kinds.
- semio/rs/lib.rs + Cargo.toml: added file/folder/archive/remote/temporary workflow helpers, remote HTTP support, and tests for all five kinds.
- semio/net/Semio/Semio.cs + semio/net/Semio.Tests/Tests.cs: added FileKit, FolderKit, ArchiveKit, RemoteKit, TemporaryKit wrapper APIs and focused workflow tests for all five kinds.

Verification:
- Go: TestKitWorkflowKinds passed (5 subtests)
- Python: 5 focused workflow tests passed
- Rust: 5 focused workflow tests passed
- .NET net8.0: 5 focused workflow tests passed
- JavaScript: workflow helpers were added, but direct Vitest verification is currently blocked by unrelated pre-existing transform/config issues in the JS workspace path; this was not introduced by the kit workflow changes.

Also fixed ancillary issues uncovered during implementation:
- Go: earlier FilterKitWithDesign pointer/value mismatch and schema path issue already corrected
- .NET: folder re-export now replaces an existing .semio/kit.db before saving in place
